identity.source_hash_note: CSV texts were normalized to LF during retrieval/save. Their stored local-byte hashes are not the published original-byte hashes. Reconstructing CRLF in memory matches all six published CSV digests; this is a verified newline-normalization explanation, not a claim of direct original-byte download.

warnings: Current source human observation overrides an implication of P64 being undamaged; close to P64 does not establish recovery of Dense.
Mean student-query MSE compares different own trajectories. Only high00 has identical U/teacher/gate between readout-static and online; other79 inputs differ for each source.

Readout local6 panel probes come from P512 split pools; full80 uses global fixed64. Full80 added74 sites and fitted parameters. Legacy gate false negative is about rejecting the mechanism before testing it, not a same-state causal claim.
P64-6 MSE only samples the six replaced sites; other74 are Q1. It cannot represent Global-P64-80 error.
Q32 outside gain is a signed net local Euclidean gain decomposition, not a causal share or a video-function fraction; values can exceed100% if inside gain negative.

Root code audit reported a possible native_modes fit/execution tensor mismatch; modes video observations are valid, but do not treat them as a completed faithful test of the intended four-mode class until resolved.
Full80 execution receipt predates human review and retains HUMAN_REVIEW_PENDING; later human JSON records qualitative review. Do not infer current lack of review from old receipt.
Human grades0-3 and intervals were not supplied. Do not fabricate ordinal scores or infer absence of damage from null fields.
No deployment latency or memory efficiency has been measured by these research runs.
Raw low-stage MSE and own-anchor increment energy both change across trajectories. Their reductions are not an additive or causal decomposition of the video improvement.
